title: Chhoti Soch | Standup Comedy Special by Shubham Pujari
description:
#standupcomedy #comedy #relationship #breakup #chhotisoch 

Hi everyone, I’m Shubham Pujari and this is my first standup comedy special, where I talk about my first ever relationship and the cultural shock that I faced when I moved to Delhi.

Baaki sab video dekh ke pata chal jaayega. If you like the video then drop a comment for a better reach. Hype the video so it reaches more audiences like you.

Also, I am coming to your cities with my NEW SHOW: https://in.bookmyshow.com/events/chhoti-soch-a-standup-solo-by-shubham-pujari/ET00479853


Link to my Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/notsopujari/

In case you are new to this channel, check out the other videos on the channel as well.
